highlight: A single prompt produces a fully interactive 3D planet with procedural terrain, multiple scientific visualization modes, day-night cycle, and atmospheric rendering — all in one self-contained HTML file.
expected_output: A standalone HTML file that renders an interactive 3D planet in the browser. The planet is procedurally generated using Perlin noise for terrain elevation. The page includes a control panel with: (1) a regenerate button to create a new random planet, (2) sliders for terrain roughness, sea level height, and rotation speed, (3) shading mode switcher supporting at least three modes — day-night map (realistic green/brown land and blue ocean), temperature map (gradient from blue/cold to yellow/hot), and humidity map. The planet rotates continuously, has a visible day-night terminator line that moves over time, and features an atmospheric glow/halo effect around the planet's edge. Visual style: dark space background, planet centered, control panel docked on the left side with a dark UI theme.
original_prompt: Design a standalone HTML page that displays a procedurally generated 3D planet model using Perlin noise for terrain. Include buttons to regenerate the planet, adjust terrain roughness, sea level height, and rotation speed. Allow switching between different shading modes (day-night map, temperature map, humidity map), and support day-night cycle effects as well as atmospheric rendering.

rounds.query: Design a standalone HTML page that displays a procedurally generated 3D planet model using Perlin noise for terrain. Include buttons to regenerate the planet, adjust terrain roughness, sea level height, and rotation speed. Allow switching between different shading modes (day-night map, temperature map, humidity map), and support day-night cycle effects as well as atmospheric rendering.

criteria.item: Opening the HTML file in a browser displays a rotating 3D sphere with procedurally generated terrain (visible continents and oceans)
criteria.evidence: 截图显示居中的 3D 星球，蓝色海洋与绿/棕色大陆、极地冰盖清晰可辨；代码用种子化 3D Perlin + fBm 在 256×256 球面上做顶点位移，rotation.y 随 rotSpeed 持续旋转

criteria.item: A control panel is visible with functional controls: a regenerate button that produces a visibly different planet, and sliders for terrain roughness, sea level height, and rotation speed that update the planet in real time
criteria.evidence: 左侧面板含 Regenerate 按钮（换种子并 rebuildPlanet）、Roughness（改 fBm gain 并按帧限流重建）、Sea level（实时更新 uSeaLevel uniform）、Rotation speed 滑块，均已在代码中接线，无 JS 报错

criteria.item: At least three shading modes can be switched between: day-night map (natural colors), temperature map (blue-to-yellow gradient), and humidity map — each producing a distinctly different visual appearance
criteria.evidence: 着色器内实现 uMode 0/1/2 三种模式：昼夜自然色、六段蓝→红温度带（含图例渐变条）、干旱→湿润湿度带，分段按钮与快捷键 1/2/3 切换

criteria.item: A day-night terminator line is visible on the planet and moves over time, indicating a day-night cycle effect
criteria.evidence: 代码中 sunAngle 随时间推进，day=smoothstep(-0.18,0.28,ndl) 形成移动晨昏线并带暖色过渡与夜面微光；初始截图太阳正对相机所以晨昏线不在视野内，属角度问题而非缺失

criteria.item: An atmospheric glow or halo effect is visible around the planet's limb/edge
criteria.evidence: 截图中星球边缘有明显蓝色光晕；代码用 BackSide 菲涅尔加性混合大气层（1.30 半径），日侧蓝、夜侧暗，可开关

criteria.item: The entire experience works as a single standalone HTML file with no external dependencies beyond what can be loaded from CDN
criteria.evidence: 单文件，仅通过 jsdelivr importmap 引入 three@0.160，无报错

flaws: 陆地配色偏白/灰：雪线阈值较低（m≈0.38 起）叠加山脊噪声抬升，导致大片陆地呈雪原/岩石色，整体像「冰期地球」，不如原 case 的翠绿大陆鲜活
地形与海岸线细节偏软、边缘糊状，近看缺乏锐利层次
初始视角太阳正对相机，截图中看不到晨昏线（代码已实现，但首屏少了昼夜对比的惊艳感）
大气光晕半径偏大（1.30），边缘蓝色光壳略显厚重
judge.gap: 功能与结构完整对齐原 case：三种着色模式、昼夜循环、大气、星空、左侧深色面板全部到位，面板精致度甚至超过原 case。差距主要在星球观感：原 case 昼夜模式是鲜绿大陆+深蓝海洋的类地行星，复现因雪线偏低、山脊抬升过强而大片发白，像冰冻星球；地形细节也偏软。整体是一件完成度很高的作品，但第一眼的生命力略逊于原 case。
judge.fix_hint: 让昼夜模式更像地球：降低雪线覆盖（只有极高海拔和极地才是白色）、让中低海拔大陆以鲜绿/森林色为主、海洋蓝色更深更通透，并提高地形噪声的对比度让海岸线更锐利清晰。

rounds.query: Design a standalone HTML page that displays a procedurally generated 3D planet model using Perlin noise for terrain. Terrain noise should have high contrast so coastlines are sharp and crisp. Include buttons to regenerate the planet, adjust terrain roughness, sea level height, and rotation speed. Allow switching between different shading modes (day-night map, temperature map, humidity map), and support day-night cycle effects as well as atmospheric rendering.
